part.text:
All 435 tests pass.

The bug was in `OrderedMultiDict.__eq__` at `boltons/dictutils.py:361`: the comparison `other[selfk] == self[selfk]` was a bare expression whose result was discarded, so any mapping with matching keys compared equal regardless of values. Changed it to `if other[selfk] != self[selfk]: return False`. This also fixes `QueryParamDict.__eq__`, which delegates to the OMD comparison.
